args.title: Fix weekly scheduled exports skipping their first run
args.body:
File: src/export/scheduler.ts

In `nextRunAt`, the "weekly" branch always advances by 7 days after setting the hour to `RUN_HOUR_UTC`, unlike the "daily" branch, which only advances a day when the computed run time has already passed (`if (next <= from) next.setUTCDate(...)`). As a result, a weekly schedule created before `RUN_HOUR_UTC` on its chosen day (e.g. 05:40 UTC on a Monday) never fires that same day: the unconditional `+7` pushes its first run a full week out, even though the run time hasn't passed yet. A schedule created after `RUN_HOUR_UTC` correctly waits a week, which is why the August test (created at 09:00) appeared to work while the October one (created at 05:40) did not.

Please add the same "has this run time already passed?" check to the weekly case that the daily case uses, so a weekly schedule created before the run hour on its target day fires that same day instead of a week later, while schedules created after the run hour still wait a full week.
